scope: Exact executable raw width<=2 check; excluding empty clauses makes the project one-or-two width theorem applicable.
Global unit preparation, immediate empty-clause rejection and checked component extraction retained.
Each nonempty binary component invokes actual OrientationRecognition.decideTwo, whose proof applies project TwoSat.sat_iff.
Wider components invoke frozen UnitPreparedDecision.solveCNF via ComponentSplit.verdict.
Public finite typed-CNF decision has SAT/UNSAT equivalence and never returns none.
limits: The reused 2SAT decision is a bounded rotation/list-closure procedure, not a newly verified linear SCC implementation.
No full encoded-bit runtime theorem or universal wall-time improvement.
Connected components with clauses wider than two can still trigger exponential fallback.
Decision output only; no satisfying assignment is returned by this public wrapper.
